'''Incinerator tanks''',<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/tribe-episode-guide|text="Tribe" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}}</ref> also known as '''AAT Incinerators''', were a type of [[Armored Assault Tank Mk I|Armored Assault Tank]]<ref name="AAT" /> utilized as [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[tank]]s supplied to and used by [[Trandoshan]] hunting parties on the [[planet]] [[Kashyyyk]] to deforest large swaths of the planet's jungle and to wipe out [[Wookiee]] villages.<ref name="Tribe">{{TBB|Tribe}}</ref>

==Characteristics==
Imperial Armored Assault Tanks were a version of the [[Armored Assault Tank Mk I|AAT]]<ref name="AAT" /> previously used by the 
[[Trade Federation]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="SWEComp">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> The tank was equipped with [[flamethrower]]s in the place of [[laser cannon]]s. They also had an additional anti-personnel weapon in each side's flanks, a longer rear bumper and an additional external seat for a [[turret]] [[gunner]] behind the [[commander]] hatch.<ref name="Tribe" />

==History==
Sometime in or around [[19 BBY]], during the early stages of the [[Pacification of Kashyyyk]], the [[Galactic Empire]] enlisted the aid of Trandoshan [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] to assist in the deforestation of the planet's vast jungle. Supplied with Armored Assault Tanks, the Trandoshans proceeded to burn down large sectors of jungle to make way for Imperial industrialization.<ref name="Tribe" />

Soon after this process had begun, [[Clone Force 99]] arrived on Kashyyyk with the renegade [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]], [[Gungi]], with the intent of returning to Wookiee to his people. After coming across a destroyed Wookiee village, the group spotted a small convoy of two Imperial Armored Assault Tanks and Trandoshan mercenaries with a bounded [[Wookiee warrior]] in tow. The group quickly dispatched the Trandoshans and the two Imperial tanks before escaping after freeing the Wookiee prisoner.<ref name="Tribe" />

Soon after, a larger convoy of Imperial Armored Assault Tanks, [[Clone trooper|clone stormtroopers]], and Trandoshans under the command of [[Commander]] [[Babwa Venomor]] arrived to the scene of the skirmish. The clones recognized the [[lightsaber]] cuts on the destroyed tanks, and suggested informing Imperial command to the presence of a Jedi. Venomor instead insisted that he and his mercenaries would be able to eliminate the Jedi first.<ref name="Tribe" />

The convoy and all of its tanks would soon after be [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Clone Force 99)|ambushed and destroyed]] due to the combined efforts of Clone Force 99 and Wookiee warriors.<ref name="Tribe" />
